facts.text: Hub for programmatic document and data-file work - creating, parsing, editing, and converting the common office and data formats in Python and Node.js. Each former standalone format skill is now an on-demand reference file under this hub's references/; when a task matches a routing-table row, Read that references/<name>.md file before answering.

The boundary that defines this hub: it owns the file format - bytes in, bytes out, and the libraries that manipulate them. When the real question is the analysis of the data, the extraction of content from messy sources, or the prose quality of a written document, defer to the sibling hubs (da-* / content-ingestion-extraction / writing-expert).
